implementation.implementation: Source-cloud local renewal plus separate moving gap mist.
Six source-road lanes, solid cars, separate physical speeds and filtered minimum headways.
One longer commuter bus on the existing upper road, sharing the lane speed and a reserved birth gap.
Ten independent source-emitter programmes, including bright cores, and bounded local glow.
Source-bound water movement, selected sign-linked river/floor response and small vehicle wet-road streaks.
Exterior rain, optically refractive glass beads, sliding/holding tracks and one explicit two-drop merge.
Gap wisps substituted for rooftop emission: no unambiguous vent grille was available on this source.
Seeded, overlapping cup wisps against the dark sofa.
Held occupancy groups and existing red-core mast modulation; many windows remain steady.
Brief coupled table-lamp core/table-reflection dips in linear light.
Two original leaf cutouts moving over confined generated clean background.
Small service ferry on retraced open water north of the foreground tower roof, with narrow wake.

review_timing: Bus:8–26s. Lamp dips:20.4/20.72s and47.15s. Ferry:approximately37–52s, behind the central foreground tower line. Signs, rain, traffic, water, steam and leaf motion continue through the minute.
caveats: The two leaves, procedural bus and tiny ferry are included as experiments. Gap mist replaces an unsupported rooftop-vent claim. Water masks were retraced after the legacy seeds caught rooftops/bridge pixels. A minimum headway filter and bus reservation replace raw random births; random times alone do not guarantee safe spacing.

future_sfx: Rain filtered through closed glass; quiet room air.
Optional distant low road/bus wash, tied to the same transit clock.
No automatic sounds for lights, laptop, steam or leaves; no sharp horn.
